task_title: Show range/damage numbers for spells that target others

plan_review.notes: Blocking: (1) base-only numbers mislead -> every summary now ends with an explicit "Base — scales with INT & mastery" suffix; (2) fireball radiusTiles is both reach and blast -> labelled "Target & blast radius". Non-blocking, all adopted: abilities-lab tooltip wired too; drift tests assert exact per-spell strings; callback named getAbilityEffectSummary; tileSizeFt passed explicitly from floorMap config; e2e observe-before-done via main-scene-probe on the real modals at 1280x720 and 960x540.

rounds.notes: Full-diff review incl. the ModalPickerUI fit-to-content change (hit areas, bevels, backdrop, uiScale, node translation, grow-only reset per rerender), formatter coverage of all 8 CatalogEffect spell variants, percent-vs-flat parity with foldLegacyStatModifier, engine->game layer boundary, and test coverage. No findings.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly derives spell statistics from the ability registry without duplicating data. The logic to handle dynamic modal heights is well-implemented with a solid two-pass approach that cleanly shifts contents. Layer boundaries are perfectly respected via the scene options callback, and both unit and E2E coverage provide strong confidence.
